result.markdown:
For most small teams, **I'd recommend HubSpot as the best overall CRM.** It's relatively easy to learn, has a strong free version, and can grow with your business.

However, the best choice depends on whether you're managing sales leads, existing customers, projects, or business development.

Here are my top five picks for 2026.

## Best CRMs for small teams

![HubSpot + Outbound Best Practices: How to Build a Predictable Pipeline Engine](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fRaXjaIhlPuB-R-vp4pPeoGZlftvdgXSxyn6Q2rF42Kvv67ncid10g7lK3I8Ts0KBOUtWU1e_TFh69Ct3Yd7iXz5hetANX31x3M_throOc-8gj_ptcYrP0lMRBY1bi8qNHq1cblhhZaZ0YHkqql9Vi2haPe6jLaATcrIrrFWSWPloM1A0RgNH3M1Ze3FRXoV?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot**

(Best overall)

- Free plan available
- Contact and deal management
- Email tracking and sales pipeline
- Marketing and customer service tools

Best for teams wanting an all-in-one platform.

[Explore HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive Culture | Comparably](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LL0qs5ZEn5bajHXZMpCmlJ4Q8G8bG-uCRPdMDaugOTZ5M83xr5SdfSJtpaTsU9pV5XZU_j6tdK98aLeb5eQtmf3jAulEyqWXtwu_NCqqantmt4RgTKgW92e5jqAqiwI5Gvz6HoJSFRLf0DV2WCKF0F5we1qdhyYgERFOvFPWSwO__wWT47lukE3R9cSOeuBr?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Very intuitive sales pipeline
- Tracks deals and follow-ups
- Sales activity reminders
- Easy to see where every opportunity stands

Best for teams focused on closing deals.

[Explore Pipedrive](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

(Best value)

- Free plan for up to 3 users
- Strong customization
- Sales automation
- Reporting and analytics

Best for budget-conscious teams wanting flexibility.

[Explore Zoho CRM](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Freshsales Reviews, Pricing, Key Info, and FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/K07S4lupkbqzQ7IJWsbLQDl_aw7G-Q5ck81gT3hTCuqSl43anPhnfDFmDbefUOdxVsjYLm_LYWgGTWI98sFAWedta2QsUixC7OM_PM1s6Y1EuFzTcZSsdi41c8KkyM-mHP8elkKTEPCnO2Il_HO6e_HYAMF4L3eSNfQjDBIzFOFumlny6cGeRX7F_U4CyLr6?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Affordable paid entry plan
- Built-in phone, email and chat
- Lead scoring and automation
- Sales-focused features

Best for teams that communicate with prospects frequently.

[Explore Freshsales](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![Press | Less Annoying CRM](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2qatplq6csyuUFkgeu64DSNLeY1k3cfYZWtzzFx81-c9TcZwWoUySRvz6Fs_wbvTDD91lMvffHRk9HGZjKJwM802Tzpg6G1lsG_WO2SDnAIYdxUaCBlEmMtjHt5udyeu9XPFQM7DZtURs4rTvF4j6_iAo16T_2yOMKSVsb9SbIreD6LNJw75WslzAFEEf8mP?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Less Annoying CRM**

- Simple interface
- Straightforward contact management
- Calendar and task tracking
- One uncomplicated pricing plan

Best for teams that don't want complicated software.

[Explore Less Annoying CRM](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/)

## Pricing comparison

Approximate US starting prices, per user/month. Paid prices generally reflect annual billing.

| CRM | Starting price | Best use |
|--------|--------|--------|
| HubSpot | Free | All-around CRM |
| Pipedrive | \$14 | Sales pipeline |
| Zoho CRM | \$14 | Value and flexibility |
| Freshsales | \$9 | Sales communication |
| Less Annoying CRM | \$15 | Simplicity |


Pricing and free-tier limits can change; check the vendor plans before purchasing. [smallbusinesssoftwareguide.com](https://smallbusinesssoftwareguide.com/guides/best-crm-software-for-small-teams/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.spotsaas.com](https://www.spotsaas.com/blog/best-crm-software-2026-reviews-pricing-feature-comparison?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[getcoherence.io](https://getcoherence.io/blog/best-crm-tools-small-teams?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a small business\:

- **1–3 people\:** HubSpot or Zoho.
- **3–10 people\:** HubSpot or Pipedrive.
- **Sales-focused team\:** Pipedrive.
- **Marketing and sales together\:** HubSpot.
- **Keep costs low\:** Freshsales or Zoho.
